Robinhood Chain dex volumes surged to new all time highs over the last two weeks.

This happened despite daily active wallets remaining relatively unchanged.

Returning users are actively deploying more capital.

We have yet to see the next massive wave of new retail enter the ecosystem.

Reminder that the Robinhood App has only listed two projects from its chain so far.

@vladtenev has made it clear that he is going to prioritize growing the chain moving forward and integrating more use cases directly into the app.

This is one of the most natural and easy onboarding ramps we've ever seen in crypto with any chain.

It's only a matter of time before that's reflected in wallet activity, and we see a new surge in both users and capital deployed.

As ETH & BTC keep pushing higher, retail will naturally gravitate back toward the trenches and look for opportunities to outperform.

After the type of growth a lot of the newer names saw over the last couple of weeks, it's natural for another cool-off / consolidation period back to quality.

Look for good names that have good discounts that have a thesis you believe will hold up over the next few months, and just trust the growth of the chain from there.

You're still very early.
